# SNOW

> SNOW is a premium oral care brand specializing in professional-grade teeth whitening kits, strips, serums, and complementary dental hygiene products featuring innovative LED technology and enamel-safe ingredients like hydroxyapatite.

SNOW offers a comprehensive range of at-home teeth whitening solutions designed for sensitive teeth, from wired and wireless LED whitening kits to dissolving strips, whitening pens, and advanced oral care devices. The brand combines professional-strength whitening technology with enamel-protective formulas to deliver visible results without sensitivity.
